'''Almec's office''' was an office in [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] that belonged to [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Almec/Legends|Almec]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="co" /> It was almost identical to the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze's]] throne room, but darker. On the side walls of the office are busts of the former Prime Ministers of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] government on pedestals.
